validation_notes: From late June through late July, VET has been trading in a tight horizontal range between roughly 0.0043 and 0.0050 with no clear convergence - both the highs and lows are essentially flat, not narrowing into an apex. This looks like a flat consolidation/rectangle rather than a descending triangle, which requires a distinctly falling upper trendline (lower highs) against a flat support. The recent highs (mid-July ~0.0049, late July ~0.0048) are roughly equal rather than declining, so the 'descending' resistance line the algorithm may have drawn is questionable. There's no strong compression narrowing toward an apex near the right edge - price action looks more like sideways chop after a prior downtrend. I lean toward rejecting the triangle label, though the range is tight enough that a very gentle drift could be argued either way.
